in_pashto.name: Nazanina
in_pashto.meaning: اسلامي نوم چې معنی یې ده Graceful, lovely, radiant
in_pashto.long_meaning: Nazanina یو اسلامي نوم دی چې په مسلم کلتور کې ژوره روحاني اهميت لري. The name Nazanina is of Arabic origin, derived from the Arabic word 'nazana', meaning 'to please, delight, or adorn'. This beautiful and spiritual name embodies the essence of grace, loveliness, and radiance. In Islamic tradition, it represents the inner beauty and charm of a woman, as well as her ability to bring joy and happiness to those around her.
